note: Coordinates are the register's own, rounded to 1e-5 degrees (~1 m). A house published twice keeps its first point. Kunnat with no published address are listed in `without`. `skipped.no_street_name` counts addresses the register publishes with a point but no street name in either language: they are real rows that simply cannot be reached by typing a street, so they are counted here rather than quietly dropped. `skipped.no_point` counts rows with no usable geometry.
